remediationReason:
# Arrival concurrency — observer-audit stop and resumption record

Recorded before any replacement execution. Original ledger: `artifacts/simulations/arrival-concurrency-20261110-2216981442fb4823afbea2d2de6b10d2/index.json`.
SHA-256: `be6872a78a471ebb442624a100272044895a1aa119d17144497ea54aa32c721f`.

The original three-execution set stopped after BurstLike/1001
`official-arrival-burstlike-1001-7669f0983bf74b06adb043b70d495743`. Its eight files and original ledger remain immutable.
The original audit count **3** is retained: one orphan-request correlation finding
and two "Conflict/failure loser partial graph" findings. No count is overwritten.

Investigation found two attempts (sequences 2179 and 5146), both singleton groups,
with `RECONCILIATION_FAILED`, null confirmed request identity and a real successful
use-case result (`FeasibleContiguousBlockFound = true`). Their final exported
attendee paths each contain one durable Assignment on the correct day. The
observer's read failed after the use case returned. The legacy audit incorrectly
assumed every UnexpectedTechnicalFailure meant no persisted graph, conflating
observer failure with persisted corruption. The other 1,024 unexpected outcomes
remain recorded measured-path failures; they are not reclassified as conflicts.

The original disposable database is already gone. Its per-request statuses for
these two unmatched graphs were not exported separately, so a complete independent
retrospective request-state audit cannot be claimed. Preserve the three original
findings as a limitation; do not call that package a clean correctness result or
include it in the valid comparison. No confirmed duplicate Spot/day, duplicate
Attendee/day or partial singleton allocation was identified in retained evidence.

The correction performs read-only correlation against each future run's final
persisted snapshot, requiring an actual Completed request, exact members/day/time,
one request graph, complete single-Zone contiguous placement and Assignment
identity. It does not change attempt outcomes, business execution, arrivals,
conflict classification, retry count, transactions or persistence. Focused tests
include valid committed observer failure, partial graph, inconsistent status and
known-conflict cases; the full solution and harness must pass before resumption.

After validation, preserve Moderate/1001 and /2001, whose audits passed. Replace
only the stopped BurstLike/1001 evidence collection and execute the still-unrun
BurstLike/2001. Record both in a new ledger chained to the stopped ledger, with
source hashes proving every prior src file is unchanged and only the read-only
resolver is added. The old harness hashes and excluded package remain linked.

This gives four valid initial-matrix runs and **five actual official execution
attempts**, including the excluded stopped run. It is a documented harness-audit
replacement, not an adaptive Seed 3001 run. No additional execution beyond the
six-attempt cap is authorized. Decide any remaining adaptive expansion only after
reviewing the completed valid four-run matrix. A real unresolved structural
invariant finding still stops execution and cannot be averaged away.

interpretation.originalIntent: Production-like Arrival Concurrency; original contract and filenames retained for traceability.
interpretation.correction: Post-run analysis identified sustained overload after official runs recorded hundreds/thousands of active requests. Severe degradation remains observable without a synchronized start barrier under the tested high-rate open-loop arrival patterns. The experiment does not yet establish whether concurrency is material under plausible festival arrival rates.
interpretation.offeredRateComparison: Moderate: 1 / 0.025 = 40 offered req/s. Burst-like: 4 / 0.065 = approximately 61.5 offered req/s. Both exceed C1 reference successful service rate: 29.593, approximately 29.6 req/s (unweighted mean of three retained S8 C1 runs; not a universal capacity ceiling).
interpretation.accumulationInterpretation: Offered arrivals exceed reference service rate; unfinished work accumulates, active concurrency and contention grow, request duration increases and backlog grows further. This is the most direct analytical interpretation, not a mathematically proven queueing model. Finite daily workloads drain; no infinite measured queue is claimed.
interpretation.s8Boundary: C4/C16 deliberately synchronize release within bounded windows; these open-loop schedules continue arrivals while earlier work is active without a small fixed concurrency bound. Neither experiment independently represents production.
interpretation.businessArrivalContext: S2: 1,464 requests/FestivalDay; 15:00–16:00 is the highest average hourly bucket at 20%. 292.8 nominal, exactly 293 allocated requests/hour, approximately 0.081 req/s. Tested sustained rates are roughly 490–756 times that average. Business-scenario averages do not exclude short bursts or real-user concurrency spikes.
interpretation.productionBoundary: Observed conflicts (approximately 79% Moderate and 69–74% Burst-like), technical failure rates, latencies and hundreds/thousands of active requests are not production predictions.
interpretation.integrityBoundary: PersistedInvariantViolationCount = 0 in all four valid runs protects the scoped persisted-integrity finding under severe overload, not operational success. The stopped collection retains three original findings and cannot be retrospectively certified clean; remediation history is unchanged.
interpretation.outcomeBoundary: Lower Burst-like ConflictRate does not indicate better behavior: many attempts shifted to UnexpectedTechnicalFailure. Interpret the complete outcome mix without changing classifications.
interpretation.nextTask: Define Plausible Festival Arrival Concurrency Experiment
interpretation.futureDesignBoundary: Model plausible temporal dispersion from the business workload rather than deriving arrival rates primarily from API latency. Distinguish OfferedRequestRate, ActiveConcurrency and ConflictRate; avoid sustained offered load that automatically accumulates backlog without a small bound unless overload is the objective. Final intervals, compression factors and run counts remain undefined.
interpretation.roadmap: Reframe evidence (completed); define plausible festival concurrency; execute bounded Lean concurrency validation; define/execute Late Large Groups with Reconfiguration; MVP Technical Feasibility Gate.
interpretation.preservationBoundary: Additive documentary interpretation metadata only, not generated by the unchanged offline analyzer. All original fields, measured values, run identities, checksums, raw packages and remediation history are unchanged. No additional scenario runs or mitigation selected.
